matrixInterpretation.fullRunAccounting: Do not represent any Linux 177-test run as zero-skip or 177 passed. TRX says total=177, executed=176, passed=176, failed/error/timeout/aborted=0, and exactly one NotExecuted headed focus probe. The separate matching headed probe is an additional explicit passed execution, not a rewrite of the original full-suite counters.
matrixInterpretation.headedRequirementDecision: Ticket 22.04 literally requires regular headless coverage plus proportional additional headed/Xvfb, Chrome and Windows Edge lanes with availability made explicit; it does not require the full headless run itself to have zero skips. Separate headed-probe TRX (1/1 passed under Xvfb) satisfies that headed-probe lane when reported alongside, not in place of, the original skip. Ticket 22.03 also requires skipped/not-run work be explicit, which the run-status JSONs do. Therefore the source-bound matrix meets these literal lane requirements; do not claim an all-passed aggregate.
